Yes. We can manage the full design, supply and install route, or step in as the installation team if your kitchen has already been designed and sourced.
Do you handle structural kitchen reconfiguration?
Yes. We can deliver structural modifications where required, including layout opening, service coordination and the integration work needed when a kitchen project is part of a bigger change to the home.
Can we stay in the house during a kitchen renovation?
Usually, yes, if the work is limited to the kitchen and you can tolerate dust, noise and a temporary cooking setup. You will be without a normal kitchen for part of the programme. We agree working hours, protection routes and key shutdowns before site starts so you can make a realistic decision.
Should we order the kitchen before appointing the installer?
Ideally the installer should review the plan, measurements, service positions and delivery schedule before the final order is placed. That catches clashes early, especially around appliances, worktop templating, extraction, fillers and older walls that are not square.
Who signs off gas and electrical work in a new kitchen?
Gas work is completed by a Gas Safe registered engineer and relevant electrical work by a qualified installer. The applicable certificates are part of the handover information, alongside appliance and product documents supplied for the project.
What happens if cabinets or appliances arrive late?
We plan procurement and confirm critical lead times before strip-out. If a supplier delay still occurs, we resequence work where practical and tell you immediately how it affects the programme. Starting demolition before key products are confirmed is one of the easiest avoidable causes of kitchen delay.
How do you control kitchen renovation costs?
We define the build scope, product allowances, exclusions and responsibilities before work starts. Changes are priced and agreed before they are carried out. The biggest cost risks are usually late layout changes, unresolved appliance specifications and structural work discovered after design has already been fixed.

Construction and renovation projects are inherently complex and prone to delays and errors. However, using a company that has your best interest at heart, you can minimize risks and turn a potentially stressful situation into a rewarding experience.

Our pricing is clear and straightforward – we offer upfront estimates and detailed quotes to ensure you understand every aspect of the cost for our services. No surprises, just honesty and trust.
Long-lasting quality
Exceptional craftsmanship, attention to detail, and a commitment to perfection in every project. We don’t just meet expectations; we exceed them, delivering results you’ll love for years to come.
Trusted for over 10 years
For over 10 years, homeowners across London have trusted us to bring their vision to life. Your trust drives our commitment to deliver exceptional quality, reliability, and results that truly feel like home.
Convenient and hassle-free
We handle all services under one roof, making your project more convenient and saving you time and effort. Planning, design, construction, and finishing touches.

Insurance protection
We provide comprehensive insurance protection up to £10 million, safeguarding your investment and ensuring your project is in safe hands.
Customer service
Try outstanding for a change. Our 5-star rated customer service and Houzz awards for service excellence speak for themselves.
Our pre-build approach
We have refined our process with you in mind. Our pre-build approach ensures you feel confident and informed at every step. With a customer-first mindset, we turn your vision into a clear, comprehensive, hassle-free plan.

We begin with a friendly call to discuss your project, understand your needs, and align our expertise with your vision.

Once you are happy with the initial discussions, we schedule an on-site meeting to finalize details, assess your space, and align with your expectations.

Final Quote & Next Steps:
After gathering all the details, we provide a final quote so you can move forward confidently, knowing exactly what to expect.
